pages.text: Villagers sell more than the old trades: farmers sell Farmer's Delight seeds and pies, fishermen Aquaculture tackle, leatherworkers waterskins and furs, masons Create Deco and roof blocks.$(br2)Smiths sell bronze tools, armour and Spartan alloy weapons; cartographers sell sealed rumours.

Nothing a Blueprint locks is ever on sale. Pies and preserved meat cost half again as much in $(bold)winter$(), when nothing grows.$(br2)Curing a villager still makes it cheaper, but never nearly free: the discount from a cure is capped.
